title: Affine Current Algebras, Virasoro, and Sugawara

items.title: Restricted affine-current module
items.statement: Define a restricted affine-current module of complex level k: for every vector v and current x, all sufficiently large positive modes x_n annihilate v. This definition includes no derivation or unitarity assumption.

items.title: Witt algebra of Laurent polynomial vector fields
items.statement: Define the Laurent-polynomial derivations d_m=-z^(m+1)d/dz and their Witt bracket [d_m,d_n]=(m-n)d_(m+n).

items.title: The normalized adjoint Casimir is a positive scalar
items.statement: For a finite-dimensional complex simple g and its normalized invariant form B, prove the adjoint Casimir acts by a unique positive scalar gamma_B.

items.title: Dual Coxeter number for the normalized invariant form
items.statement: For B normalized so long roots have square 2, define h^vee as half the scalar by which the Casimir Omega_B acts in the adjoint representation; the scalar's existence and positivity are proved locally.

items.title: Positive-energy unitary module for an affine current algebra
items.statement: Define the compact real form, unitary mode adjoints, finite-dimensional nonnegative energy grading, central level, and ground-space condition; distinguish the energy operator -d from the loop central extension.

items.title: Restricted Sugawara quadratic mode sums are well defined
items.statement: For a restricted affine-current module, prove each normal-ordered quadratic mode sum is locally finite on every vector and independent of the chosen dual bases.

items.title: A normalized Witt central cocycle is cubic
items.statement: A skew central cocycle supported on m+n=0 and normalized by a(1,-1)=0 has a(m,-m)=c(m^3-m)/12.

items.title: The cubic Witt cocycle is a Lie-algebra two-cocycle
items.statement: For omega(d_m,d_n)=delta_(m+n,0)(m^3-m)/12, prove alternatingness and the cyclic Lie-algebra two-cocycle identity.

items.title: Sugawara modes and their normal ordering
items.statement: For level k with k+h^vee nonzero, define L_m=(2(k+h^vee))^-1 sum_a sum_r :J_a(r)J^a(m-r):, with the chosen dual-basis and positive-energy normal-ordering convention.

items.title: Virasoro algebra in the L_m convention
items.statement: Define the central extension [L_m,L_n]=(m-n)L_(m+n)+(c/12)(m^3-m)delta_(m+n,0), with central generator c, using the fixed d_m=-z^(m+1)d/dz convention.

items.title: An irreducible unitary affine module has irreducible ground space
items.statement: For an irreducible positive-energy unitary module as defined, the finite-dimensional ground space is an irreducible module for the compact zero-mode algebra.

items.title: Highest-weight vector and module for Virasoro
items.statement: Define a Virasoro highest-weight vector v by L_n v=0 for n>0, L_0v=hv, and define its highest-weight module as the submodule it generates; impose no irreducibility or unitarity claim.

items.title: The Sugawara mode-one commutator
items.statement: For compact X in the declared positive-energy unitary regime, prove [L_m,X(0)]=0 and [L_m,X(1)]=-X(m+1), including all normal-order boundary and central terms.

items.title: Sugawara current commutators on every restricted module
items.statement:
Let $V$ be any restricted affine-current module of level $k\in\mathbb C$ as in [[def-positive-energy-affine-module]], for a finite-dimensional complex simple $\mathfrak g$ with normalized invariant form $B$. Put $q=k+h^\vee\ne0$ and use [[def-sugawara-modes]]. Then for every $x\in\mathfrak g$ and $m,n\in\mathbb Z$,
$$[L_m,J_x(n)]=-nJ_x(m+n).$$
No grading, inner product, irreducibility, or integrability of $V$ is required.

items.title: Sugawara modes act on affine currents with weight one
items.statement:
Let $V$ be a restricted affine-current module of any complex level $k\ne-h^\vee$ as in [[def-positive-energy-affine-module]]. For the modes of [[def-sugawara-modes]], every $x\in\mathfrak g$ and $m,n\in\mathbb Z$ satisfy
$$[L_m,J_x(n)]=-nJ_x(m+n).$$
In particular this holds on all positive-energy unitary modules in the previously considered nonnegative integral level branch.

items.title: Sugawara modes satisfy Virasoro at every noncritical complex level
items.statement:
Let $\mathfrak g$ be a finite-dimensional complex simple Lie algebra with invariant form $B$ normalized so long roots have square $2$. On every restricted affine-current module $V$ of complex level $k\ne-h^\vee$ as in [[def-positive-energy-affine-module]], the operators of [[def-sugawara-modes]] satisfy
$$[L_m,L_n]=(m-n)L_{m+n}+\frac{c}{12}(m^3-m)\delta_{m+n,0}I_V,\qquad c=\frac{k\dim\mathfrak g}{k+h^\vee}.$$
Consequently these operators and $C\mapsto cI_V$ define a representation of [[def-virasoro-algebra]]. No energy grading, unitarity, irreducibility or integrability is assumed. The critical level is excluded from this normalized formula.

title: Affine Current Algebras, Virasoro, and Sugawara: Examples and Counterexamples

items.title: The normalized Sugawara formula is undefined at critical level
items.statement: The claim that the displayed normalized Sugawara operator formula defines modes at the critical level is false; for sl2 at k=-2 its denominator is zero.

items.title: The level-one sl2 Sugawara central charge
items.statement: For normalized sl2, dim(g)=3 and h^vee=2, so the level-one Sugawara central charge is 1.

items.title: The level-zero trivial sl2 module
items.statement: On the one-dimensional trivial affine sl2 module at level zero, all Sugawara modes and the central charge vanish.
